answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 86 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in ferrous, queued in inlet, and shale publishes the wait time. A farm of 127 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2695 identities would post 820 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
